{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ancient Houses''', also known as the '''Senex and Juvex Houses''', were a narrow group of old-established [[Human/Legends|Human]] bloodlines controlling [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] fiefs and interstellar [[Lord/Legends|lordships]]. The term could sometimes be extended to include other families of comparable antiquity and authority&mdash;for example, [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]&mdash;but the original meaning of the term indicated the dominant lineages of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]]-[[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]], such as [[House Vandron]] and [[House Elegin/Legends|House Elegin]].<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
